messages:
Lina (PM): quick async: two customers asked for 'live evidence access' (queryable UI) vs our export-only plan. need a decision for next quarter.
Diego (Eng): queryable UI = index + per-tenant RBAC + signed transcripts. Rough estimate: +2 infra sprints, +1 API sprint.
Maya (Security): bigger attack surface. Exports are preferable for legal chain-of-custody. If we do EaaS, it must produce signed transcripts identical to export artifacts.
Ethan (Product): customers need minutes-level retrieval for legal holds. Can we do export-first with an expedited pathway (2h) for Enterprise?
Sam (Legal): exports are easier to accept in discovery. Live queries could work if we provide signed, time-stamped transcripts and manifest with signature.
Lina (PM): proposed plan: Phase 1 = export-first MVP with on-demand expedited export for Enterprise (2h target). Phase 2 = read-only EaaS with transcript signing and RBAC. Approve?
Diego (Eng): engineering caveat: expedited exports must be incremental diffs to stay cost-effective. Full dumps for many customers will spike egress.
Maya (Security): incremental diffs OK, but require signed manifest + retention-policy-version. Also require that expedited exports can be pinned (not deleted) until legal hold cleared.
Ethan (Product): we'll require justification and rate-limits for expedited exports. Add a UI field: "legal_reference_id" and a required contact email.
Sam (Legal): manifest must include chain_of_custody array and legal_reference_id when provided. Also include export_hash = sha256(gzip_payload).
Diego (Eng): export API draft:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/t-123/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"start":"2025-03-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2025-03-02T00:00:00Z","expedite":true,"legal_reference_id":"LR-42"}'

Lina (PM): acceptance checklist (Phase 1):
- POST export API (params: window, expedite flag, legal_reference_id)
- Standard delivery SLA: 48h; expedited (Enterprise only): 2h
- Export format: gzip(ndjson) + manifest.json with sha256 and chain_of_custody
- Expedited: rate-limited and requires contact + justification
- BYOK: include wrapped_key metadata in manifest; ops-handshake for activation
- Retention toggle per tenant in admin (default 90d)
- Oncall paging on export generation failure > 3 retries

Maya (Security): add requirement: all manifests signed by our key + server_nonce. For BYOK tenants, include key_wrap_info but do not auto-decrypt.
Diego (Eng): implementation tasks (estimate):
- export generator + gzip/ndjson packaging (1 sprint)
- manifest gen + sha256 + signing (0.5 sprint)
- incremental export pipeline & diffing (1 sprint)
- BYOK metadata validation + pre-checker (0.5 sprint)

Ethan (Product): ops concern: expedited exports could be abused. add product ops alerts and quota enforcement.
alerts-bot: Created alert: expedited_export_rate_per_tenant > 3/day -> notify product-ops. Created alert: export_generation_failures > 0.5% -> page oncall.
Sam (Legal): require contract language for expedited exports and retention overrides; provide customer-facing manifest template.
Lina (PM): decision needed: ship Phase 1 as export-first with expedited export, Phase 2 EaaS later. Vote?
Diego (Eng): :thumbsup:
Maya (Security): :thumbsup: will write signing spec for Phase 2 transcripts
Sam (Legal): :thumbsup: legal okay with export-first.
Ethan (Product): :thumbsup: will update roadmap and create GH tickets.
Lina (PM): thanks. I'll open issues for export API, expedited flow, manifest format, BYOK metadata, and retention toggle. Ping me if you want to be assigned.
